dtype: integer nanoseconds (host wall clock, u128) over an integer-only discrete stack; no floating point
exclusion: no apply/update is timed: every cell asserts an unchanged snapshot digest and epoch, so these are forward-only carry+propose+observe batches and NOT a training dose
rates_basis: full timed unit: carry_windows + propose(route) + observation + propose(vector_block) + observation
rates_secondary: carry_only rows_per_s and padded_context_tokens_per_s are reported separately and are NOT the headline basis
synchronization: Device::synchronize before and after every timed operation
zero_apply_assertion: snapshot digest and epoch identical before and after each cell
